home.summary: Rina nail is a fully private, by-appointment nail salon in Hirao-cho, Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, Japan. The owner, a nail artist with ten years of experience, handles everything from the consultation to the finish herself, one guest at a time. We recommend fill-in work, which helps reduce the strain on your natural nails, and we cover everything from a simple one-colour to elaborate art. There is a large car park, and men are welcome.

hero.subtitle: Fill-in work that looks after your natural nails, so you can enjoy them for longer.
hero.lead: Gentle fill-in nails in a completely private, one-to-one space.

lineTwo: Kind to your nails, bright in your own way.

concept.heading: Time set aside for one person.
concept.lead: A private, one-to-one space where the treatment is shaped around the condition of your nails.
body: Rina nail is a by-appointment private nail salon in Hirao-cho, Yokkaichi. Because no two guests are ever booked at the same time, you can relax without worrying about anyone else in the room.

During the consultation we look at the condition of your nails, your daily routine and the look you have in mind, then suggest a design and a method that will not strain them. Even if you are only vaguely curious about something, please feel free to ask.

features.lead: A small salon means the treatment can be built around you.

items.title: Fill-in recommended

items.title: Ten years as a nail artist

items.title: A finish that lifts less and lasts

items.title: Large car park

items.title: Men are welcome

items.title: Cashless payment accepted

items.title: Same-day and out-of-hours enquiries

fillIn.heading: What fill-in means
fillIn.lead: Rebalancing your nails without filing everything away each time.
fillIn.body: We keep one layer of base gel, tidy up the regrowth and any lifting, then build the new colour or art on top. Compared with removing all of the gel every time, this puts less strain on your natural nails. Depending on their condition we may still recommend a full removal.

fillIn.title: What fill-in means
fillIn.lead: Keeping one layer of base gel, so there is less strain on your natural nails.
fillIn.summary: Fill-in means keeping one layer of base gel in place and rebalancing mainly the regrowth before building the new design on top. Compared with a full removal, where all of the gel is filed away each time, it reduces how often the surface of your natural nail is touched. Rina nail recommends fill-in, though depending on the condition of your nails we may suggest a full removal instead.

whatIs.heading: What fill-in means
body: Fill-in is a way of renewing gel nails while leaving one layer of base gel in place. We work mainly on the regrowth at the cuticle and on any areas that have lifted, then build the new colour or art on top.
Compared with filing away all of the gel each time, the surface of your natural nail is touched far less often. That is why it is chosen as a method that is gentler on your own nails.

difference.heading: How it differs from a full removal
difference.caption: Fill-in compared with a full removal

rows.item: How often the natural nail is filed
rows.normalOff: Every time the set is renewed

rows.fillIn: Guests who renew their nails regularly
rows.normalOff: Guests taking a break from nails

rows.fillIn: Colour and art can still be changed

items.title: Less strain on your natural nails
items.body: Because the surface is filed less often, there is less strain overall.

items.title: Lifts less, lasts longer
items.body: Building on base that is still firmly attached means less lifting at the cuticle.

items.title: Often quicker
items.body: Without the step of filing everything away, appointments tend to be shorter.

items.title: Easier to control thickness
items.body: By balancing the layer kept against the layers added, we can keep the finish natural.

suitable.heading: Who fill-in suits
items: Guests who renew their nails regularly
Guests who want to reduce the strain on their natural nails
Guests bothered by lifting at the cuticle
Guests who prefer a natural, slim finish
Guests who want to keep roughly the same length over time

notes.heading: Things to keep in mind
items: Depending on the condition of your nails and previous work, fill-in may not be possible. In that case we will suggest a full removal.
Gel applied at another salon may not be suitable for fill-in, depending on the base product used.
Where lifting or chipping is extensive, we remove that area first and then continue.
Fill-in helps reduce the strain on your natural nails, but it does not remove it entirely. We will always suggest a method based on how your nails look on the day.

cta.heading: Make fill-in part of your next set.
cta.lead: We check the condition of your nails and suggest a method that will not push them too far.

firstVisit.title: Visiting for the first time
firstVisit.lead: From booking to the day itself, laid out so a first visit is straightforward.
firstVisit.summary: Rina nail is by appointment only. Bookings are taken through the booking site, and same-day appointments are possible subject to availability. After you arrive we confirm the condition of your nails and what you would like during the consultation, then move through care, colour and art, and finishing. We accept major credit cards, Apple Pay, iD and QUICPay. If you cannot find the salon, please contact us on the day of your visit.

booking.heading: How to book
body: Rina nail is by appointment only. Choose your preferred date, time and menu on the booking site. Bookings are confirmed immediately.
Same-day appointments are possible subject to availability, and we are happy to discuss times outside our usual hours.
You can request a specific artist and pay per visit. Points can also be used.

beforeVisit.heading: Before you come
items: If you have gel applied at another salon, please let us know when you book.
If you have pain, inflammation or any strong discomfort in your nails or fingers, please talk to us beforehand.
If you have a picture of the look you want, bringing it along makes the consultation easier.
If you are driving, please use the parking space on the property.
If you cannot find the salon, please contact us on the day of your visit.

counseling.heading: The consultation
counseling.body: We check the condition of your nails, how you spend your days, and the length, shape and design you have in mind. If this is your first set and you are not sure what you want, we will suggest something that fits your daily life.

duration.heading: How long it takes
duration.body: It depends on the menu, the design and the condition of your nails. We give you an estimate when you book and again during the consultation. Designs with a lot of decoration or full coverage may take additional time.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body: We accept major credit cards and smart payments. Payment is made per visit.

cancel.heading: Cancellations
body: If you need to change or cancel your appointment, please let us know as early as you can.
As a by-appointment salon with a single chair, a last-minute cancellation affects other guests too. We appreciate your understanding.
If something unavoidable comes up, such as illness, please get in touch.

lost.heading: If you cannot find us
lost.body: As this is a home salon, it can be a little hard to find on a first visit. Contact us on the day and we will guide you in.

cta.heading: A first booking is easy to make.

concept.heading: Our concept
body: A nail salon offering fill-in work that is gentler on your natural nails, in a completely private, one-to-one space.
Our concept is simple: kind to your nails, bright in your own way. We suggest nails you can enjoy for longer while looking after the nails underneath.
We work across a wide range, from a simple one-colour to elaborate designs with glitter and stones. If you are unsure what you want, we will work it out together during the consultation.
The salvia, the official flower of Yokkaichi, is woven through this site as a background motif.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How Rina nail ("the salon") handles personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
body: The salon collects personal information to the extent necessary to take bookings and provide its services, including your name, contact details, booking details and information about the condition of your nails.
We may use analytics tools to understand how this website is used. The information collected in this way does not identify individuals.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
body: We use the personal information we collect to manage bookings, to suggest and confirm treatments, to contact you and to improve our service.
If we need to use it beyond these purposes, we will obtain your consent in advance.

sections.heading: 3. Sharing with third parties
body: Except where required by law, we do not provide personal information to third parties without your consent.

sections.heading: 4. Security
body: We take appropriate measures to prevent personal information from being leaked, lost or damaged.

sections.heading: 5. Access, correction and deletion
body: At your request, we will disclose, correct, suspend the use of or delete the personal information we hold about you. Please contact the salon.

sections.heading: 6. Use of the booking service
body: Bookings may be taken through an external booking service. Personal information handled on that service is governed by that provider's own terms.

sections.heading: 7. Changes
body: This policy may be revised as necessary. Any revised version will be published on this page.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
body: For questions about this policy, please contact the salon through the booking site or the contact details provided.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Terms that apply to the Rina nail website and services.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
body: These terms apply to the services provided by Rina nail ("the salon") and to the use of this website.

sections.heading: 2. Bookings
body: The salon works by appointment only. Bookings are taken through the booking site.
Subject to availability, we may accept same-day bookings and discuss appointments outside our usual opening hours.

sections.heading: 3. Changes and cancellations
body: Please let us know as early as possible if you need to change or cancel a booking.
As a salon with a single chair, a last-minute cancellation affects other guests. We appreciate your cooperation.

sections.heading: 4. Treatments
body: Depending on the condition of your nails or fingers, we may be unable to carry out the treatment you requested, or may need to change it.
The salon does not provide medical treatment. If you are concerned about a condition affecting your nails or skin, we recommend consulting a medical professional.

sections.heading: 5. Prices and payment
body: All prices shown include tax.
A surcharge may apply depending on the design, the length and the amount of decoration. We will tell you in advance.
Payment is made after the appointment, per visit. Major credit cards and smart payments are accepted.

sections.heading: 6. Website content
body: Information published on this website may change without notice.
Some images on this site are placeholders prepared as design references.

sections.heading: 7. Prohibited conduct
body: Please do not copy, republish or alter the content of this website without permission.
We may decline conduct that disrupts other guests or the running of the salon.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to these terms
body: These terms may be amended as necessary. Any amended version will be published on this page.
